summary: Iteration 16 regression: 11 fix items verified end-to-end. Backend pytest 15 PASSED + 1 expected SKIP (landlord cleanup). Frontend smoke confirms all data-testids + invoice TOTALE auto-compute (€1748.00 from 500+1000+200+98-50). Specific verifications: (1) OCR /api/ocr/scan accepts image/png AND application/pdf, returns 200 with saved_file_url. _country_from_code('IRN')='Iran', 'ITA'='Italia', 'FRA'='Francia', 'DEU'='Germania'. (2) it_dictionaries.NATIONALITIES has >=100 items; it_cities.ITALIAN_CITIES has 50+ tuples [city, province sigla] including ['Padova','PD']; Tenants.js Combobox uses ITALIAN_CITIES for place_of_birth + NATIONALITIES for nationality. (3) Tenant POST 'Rossi Mario' → full_name='Rossi Mario' (Surname first preserved). Landlord same — frontend builds payload as `${surname} ${name}` in both Tenants.js:89 and Landlords.js:135. (4) GET /api/hospitality/records returns list (4 records found). POST /records is upsert by tenant_id (no separate PUT exists — see note below). UI Hospitality has 4 edit-hospitality-{id} buttons; opening edit pre-fills check_in_date with active contract value (2026-01-01). (5) POST /api/rooms/{id}/assign with tenant_id form-data → both tenant.room_id AND room.tenant_id updated. POST /api/rooms/{id}/unassign clears both sides. Properties.js renders '(€{rent/2} a persona)' hint for double rooms. (6) POST /api/payments/{id}/receipt with 1x1 PNG → 200 {url}; subsequent GET /api/payments shows receipt_url field. (7) Properties.js has data-testid='filter-available-rooms' + showOnlyAvailable state + counter ('Solo immobili con stanze libere (2)'). (8) POST /api/landlords/signature with transparent='true' → returns /api/uploads/signatures/sig_*.png (PIL RGBA + luminosity-based alpha, working). (9) Invoices Crea Fattura: rent/deposit/agency/registration/discount inputs all have testids; UI auto-computes TOTALE → €1748.00 verified (default registration=98). Backend POST /api/invoices stores amount as-is (frontend does the math). (10) Payments dialog auto-fills amount = room_rent/2 for double rooms (Payments.js:106-114). Tenants list returns room_type='double' + room_rent=700 used for the calc. (11) format.js produces DD/MM/YYYY format string.

minor.issue: Endpoint does NOT exist. The review request mentioned PUT /api/hospitality/{id} but routes/hospitality.py only defines POST /records (upsert by tenant_id), GET /records, and GET /pdf/{tenant_id}. The upsert via POST works correctly (idempotent — returns same id on repeat calls). Either the request was inaccurate, or a true PUT route should be added for clarity. Test PUT call returned 405.
Schema requires number_of_rooms + capacity (not optional). Test had to add them. Not a bug, just contract awareness.

ui_bugs.issue: Same as iter15 finding — tenant-place-of-birth, tenant-nationality, tenant-country triggers report empty inner_text via [data-testid] selector even though Combobox value state holds defaults ('Italia', 'Italiana'). Likely the value is rendered in a deeper span and the data-testid is on the outer Radix trigger. Visual verification recommended but functional behavior (select & save) works.
Console warning 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent' — accessibility concern, not breaking. Add <DialogDescription> or aria-describedby to dialogs.

action_items: (Optional) Decide: either add PUT /api/hospitality/{id} explicitly, or update the spec to reflect that hospitality update happens via POST /api/hospitality/records (upsert by tenant_id).
(Cosmetic) Add aria-describedby/DialogDescription to dialogs to silence Radix accessibility warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: hospitality.py: POST /records is upsert keyed on tenant_id — only ONE active record per tenant ever exists. If the product needs hospitality history (multiple stays per tenant), this design needs revisiting.

ocr.py: Saves original document, runs OCR, then attempts top-portion crop as profile photo using a fixed (0.3-0.7w, 0.05-0.45h) bounding box — this is a heuristic, not face detection; for ID cards the photo is often left-side. Consider replacing with a proper face detector or removing the auto-crop.

rooms.py /assign: Does not check whether target room is already occupied by a different tenant — it will silently overwrite room.tenant_id and orphan the previous tenant's room_id pointer (previous tenant still has stale room_id). Should either reject or clear the previous tenant's room_id.
payments.py /receipt: 10MB cap is generous; aligns with general policy. ALLOWED_RECEIPT_EXTS includes pdf — good.
landlords.py signature transparent algorithm uses luminosity threshold 235 with soft fade between 200-235. Robust enough for typical white-paper scans.

invoices.py POST: stores `amount` as a single field; the breakdown (rent/deposit/agency/registration/discount) is computed only client-side and NOT persisted. If a user reopens the invoice they cannot see the breakdown — only the total. Consider persisting the breakdown if the user needs to audit it later.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical testids found, TOTALE auto-compute verified, hospitality edit pre-fill verified, filter-available verified)

Two minor findings: (a) PUT /api/hospitality/{id} from review request does not exist — current implementation uses POST /records as idempotent upsert; functionally equivalent but route name differs from spec.
